research.title: Evaluating Semantic Segmentation Under Illumination Shifts
bullets: Designed experiments with supervisor guidance to assess segmentation robustness under brightness and contrast shifts, controlling training splits and augmentation settings.
Compared encoder backbones using intersection over union and classwise error analysis, examining whether illumination augmentation affected boundaries and small object predictions.

work.title: Inventory and Order Processing Support
bullets: Maintained inventory records, checked incoming deliveries against purchase orders, and coordinated discrepancy resolution with purchasing staff.
Prepared order paperwork, tracked fulfillment status, and communicated scheduling changes to internal teams during routine daily operations.

projects.title: Comparative Evaluation of Image Classification Transfer Learning
bullets: Implemented frozen feature extraction and end to end fine tuning for image classification using pretrained convolutional networks.
Compared classification accuracy and confusion patterns under matched data splits, documenting sensitivity to training set size and learning rate.

projects.title: Local Feature Matching for Planar Image Alignment
bullets: Implemented patch descriptors and nearest neighbor matching to estimate planar transformations between images with overlapping scene content.
Compared raw intensity and gradient histogram descriptors using reprojection error, inspecting alignment failures under viewpoint changes and repetitive textures.
